changelog: Remote Support Access now stays on for 4 hours instead of 1. That window has to be long enough to cover the gap between you switching it on and Cytech Support picking it up, and customers sit in time zones many hours away from ours. It still switches itself off automatically when the time is up, and you can still switch it off yourself at any moment.
details: 49a is a one-value change made for time-zone reasons: the Remote Support Access window goes from 1 hour to 4 hours. A customer pressing the toggle while the operator is asleep used to leave nothing to connect to by morning; the operator asked for a window that survives the offset (customers run up to 12 h from Cytech's time zone). TWO constants encode the window and both move together: timer.remote_support_access's duration in packages/cytech.yaml ("01:00:00" -> "04:00:00", the HA-side timer that fires cytech_remote_support_timer_expired and so switches the toggle back off) and EXPIRES in enable_remote_support.sh (3600 -> 14400 seconds, the /config/.remote_support_expires_at timestamp that first_boot.sh's ensure_ssh_admin_access() treats as the single source of truth for whether the operator key belongs in the SSH addon's authorized_keys on the next Core start). A comment in each file now names the other, since a future edit to one alone would either revoke the key while the toggle still reads on (timer longer than the timestamp) or leave the operator key installed past the moment the UI says the window closed (timestamp longer than the timer). No change to when the key is granted or revoked, to disable_remote_support.sh's revoke path, to the operator key itself, or to anything else in the fleet. dashboards/system.yaml's Remote Support card now says 4 hours (it is the only owner-facing mention of the number), and disable_remote_support.sh's header comment follows. The update restarts Core by itself (cytech_update.sh's PACKAGES_CHANGED path -- packages/cytech.yaml is in this release's files), which is what makes the new timer duration live; no owner action and no extra restart. Live-verified on cytech.local 2026-09-22: toggle on -> .remote_support_expires_at = now + 14400 and timer.remote_support_access counting down from 4:00:00, operator key present in the addon's authorized_keys within seconds, then the timer's expiry path (timer.start with a short test duration) switching the toggle off and revoking the key, and the System Health card reading 4 hours.
